value.rationale: The balanced double-star is a natural two-community bottleneck network. Its second-order optimal bridge budget has exponent minus one-third versus the known first-order exponent minus one-half, and using the wrong objectively optimal design costs an asymptotically nonvanishing 25% second-order performance penalty. This motivates the exact bridge-weight fact beyond routine algebra.
